curated.instructions: omr/instructions/8258-1-1.pdf to 8258-1-5.pdf; book numbers here follow the files' numbers. Book 3 (8 pages) shows the functions; book 5 holds build steps 64-107, book 4 the crane and steps up to 183

functions.does: The Power Functions XL motor drives the crane's four functions one at a time: the battery box's switch turns it on, the red lever with a towball handle (on the polarity switch) sets its direction, and two yellow levers on the right of the gearbox choose which function it drives (each lever up or down, or both in the middle for none).
functions.source: book: 3 pages 2-3 (motor, battery box, switch; the red lever and the yellow levers), pages 4-7 (each function's lever settings)
functions.note: the controls are the red lever p254 2736 (its handle) and the yellow levers p164 6536 and p167 6536 (first lever, with changeover catch p166 6641) and p169 6536 and p172 6536 (second lever, with catch p171 6641). The functions below are each driven by the motor (p767 58121) once the yellow levers select them; switching the motor on and off is electrical, so turning the motor's output stands in for it

functions.does: The four outriggers slide out sideways and back in, driven by the motor through gear racks under them, when the first yellow lever (the one with p164 and p167) is pushed down.
functions.source: book: 3 page 4 (arrows: the outriggers out and in; one yellow lever down)
functions.note: which of the two yellow levers, and which way, is read from the book's picture and should be checked

functions.does: The lower boom rises and lowers, pushed by the linear actuator under it, driven by the motor when the first yellow lever is pulled up.
functions.source: book: 3 page 5 (arrows: the boom up and down; one yellow lever up)

functions.does: The crane slews round on its turntable behind the cab, carrying both booms, driven by the motor when the second yellow lever (the one with p169 and p172) is pulled up.
functions.source: book: 3 page 6 (arrows: the crane turning both ways; the other yellow lever up)

functions.does: The upper boom folds up and down at the lower boom's tip, pushed by the second linear actuator, driven by the motor when the second yellow lever is pushed down.
functions.source: book: 3 page 7 (arrows: the upper boom up and down; the other yellow lever down)

functions.does: The round knob on top behind the cab steers the front two axles: a long vertical shaft takes it down to a knob gear that turns the knob gear on the steering shaft along the chassis, whose bevel gears drive the two steering racks; the front axle's wheels turn further than the second's.
functions.source: book: 5 steps 93 (vertical shaft) and 97 (knob on top); inferred: the book draws no arrow, the drive is worked out from the gears

functions.does: The V8 engine turns as the truck rolls: the two rear axles drive the long shaft along the chassis through a differential, and it turns the crankshaft in front, moving the eight pistons up and down.
functions.source: book: 5 pages 55-61 (V8, sub-steps 1-13), steps 89-91 (fitted and joined to the shaft); inferred: that the rear wheels drive it, as the book draws no arrow
functions.note: the model file has no wheels (see the next function), so the controls are the rear axles' half shafts

functions.does: The eight wheels roll; the front four steer.
functions.note: the model file places no wheels or tyres, so there's nothing to name here yet

functions.does: The hook hangs on its string from the upper boom's tip.
functions.source: book: 3 page 2 (the finished model) and the cover
functions.note: the model file never places the hook's sub-assembly: its submodel 8258 - m-1o'''' (with the 70644 hook) and fourteen others are defined but not used. Whether the string can be wound in, and how, is still to find out from the book
